tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand violet: the new-tab action, selected chips, the active state, links, page-load progress. As text it reads on surface, surface-raised and surface-container in both themes.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. In dark the violet is light and takes dark ink, so never hard-code white.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: selected chips, the active nav halo, the privacy banner strip.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft.

tokens.name: fab-start
tokens.usage: Start stop of the new-tab action's gradient and of the brand mark.

tokens.name: fab-end
tokens.usage: End stop of the new-tab action's gradient and of the brand mark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. White in light so the layout breathes; separation comes from hairlines and surface-container wells, not grey pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, the bottom bar, the search bar on the hero.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Wells and tiles inside a surface: quick tiles, inputs at rest, list leading squares, the compact address bar.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rings on tiles, chips and icon buttons; dividers. Decoration only, never the only cue for state.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: a focused input, an unchecked radio, the switch track. Holds 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-container.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: URLs, times, sizes, helper copy, inactive nav labels. 4.5:1 on all three surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: hero-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the home hero's mesh gradient. The hero is dark in both themes, so text on it is on-glass.

tokens.name: hero-violet
tokens.usage: Main glow of the hero mesh.

tokens.name: hero-rose
tokens.usage: Secondary glow of the hero mesh, lower right. Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted fill for controls and chips sitting on the hero or on a card image. Always paired with a glass-stroke ring; no backdrop blur on any version.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px ring on glass controls.

tokens.name: on-glass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on glass and on the hero.

tokens.name: on-glass-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the hero.

tokens.name: surface-incognito
tokens.usage: Chrome (address bar, bottom bar, tab cards) while an incognito tab is active. Same deep plum in both themes so incognito never reads as plain dark mode.

tokens.name: on-incognito
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-incognito.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a bottom sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failed downloads. Always with a word.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Completed download state. Always with a check icon and the word Complete.

tokens.name: tile-sky
tokens.usage: Quick setting tile: Theme.

tokens.name: tile-sky-ink
tokens.usage: Icon on tile-sky.

tokens.name: tile-sun
tokens.usage: Quick setting tile: Language.

tokens.name: tile-sun-ink
tokens.usage: Icon on tile-sun.

tokens.name: tile-peach
tokens.usage: Quick setting tile: Clear data.

tokens.name: tile-peach-ink
tokens.usage: Icon on tile-peach.

tokens.name: tile-mint
tokens.usage: Quick setting tile: Search engine.

tokens.name: tile-mint-ink
tokens.usage: Icon on tile-mint.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and D-pad focus: 2px solid ring, 2px gap.

styles.name: headlineLarge
styles.usage: The home greeting and onboarding titles. Tight tracking.

styles.name: headlineSmall
styles.usage: Large screen titles that collapse on scroll.

styles.name: titleLarge
styles.usage: Top bar titles, dialog titles, sheet titles.

styles.name: titleMedium
styles.usage: List row titles, card titles, setting names.

styles.name: titleSmall
styles.usage: Section headers in lists, day headers in History.

styles.name: bodyLarge
styles.usage: Search bar text, onboarding body, dialog body.

styles.name: bodyMedium
styles.usage: Secondary lines: URLs, setting values, descriptions.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding. Spacing.xs in code.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and between tiles, inner padding of compact controls. Spacing.sm.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, list row padding. Spacing.md.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Space between sections, sheet padding. Spacing.lg.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Top of the home hero, onboarding margins. Spacing.xl.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, the progress track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Favicons and small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tab previews, inputs inside dialogs, list leading squares.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tiles, cards, tab cards, settings groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, banners, shortcut cards on the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Search bar, chips, buttons, icon buttons, the new-tab action.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The search bar, shortcut cards, dialogs. The only elevation for content.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The bottom bar, lifted off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The new-tab action only: a glow plus a faint halo ring.
